data.location: 3003 E. 3rd Avenue, Suite B, Denver, CO 80206
data.status: plans to open in early 2027 (signed a lease)
data.short_description: Denver fast-casual restaurant BOXBOX has signed a lease in Cherry Creek and plans to open in early 2027. The space will seat 12 guests and feature an expanded menu. The move follows the restaurant's first year on East Colfax Avenue.

data.status: currently in the planning phase; slated to open
data.short_description: Restaurateur Robert St. John is planning Ed's on the Beach, a beach bar with cabanas, a volleyball court and a live music venue in downtown Gulfport. It is a spin-off of Ed's Burger Joint in Hattiesburg, part of New South Restaurant Group. The team recently met with architects to finalize the design.
New South Restaurant Group opened The Downtowner in Gulfport in June. The article mentions it as context for the group's Gulfport expansion.

data.store_name: Bell and Layton's Delicatessen and Provisions
data.status: preparing to open; expected to open next month
data.short_description: Business partners Brian Bell and Will Layton are opening a deli in Mandarin in the former Player's Grille space. Bagels, smoked lox and brined pastrami will be main offerings. Kosher and non-kosher groceries are planned for a later stage.

data.location: 9739 W Sample Rd, Coral Springs, FL 33065
data.short_description: The Melted Mallow is preparing to open a dessert shop in Coral Springs in December 2026. The menu will include hand-scooped ice cream, specialty milkshakes, sundaes, coffee and Mallow Treats. Customers can follow @MyMeltedMallow for renovation updates.

data.status: new location coming; opening date hasn't yet been announced
data.short_description: Food truck Chino's Kitchen, owned by Jesus Barraza, is teasing a new location at 806 Riverview Drive. The menu includes tacos, burgers, quesadillas, burritos and chilaquiles. The building will be shared with 13 1/2 Liquor Store.

data.location: 1005 East New Hope Drive, Cedar Park, Texas (page footer lists: 1005 E New Hope Dr, Leander, TX 78641)
data.status: listed for a location; planned restaurant project
data.short_description: Fogo de Chão is listed for a Cedar Park location with the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation. No opening date has been established. The Brazilian steakhouse chain is known for its churrasco and tableside-carved meats.

data.store_name: Unnamed Libbie Loup Hospitality restaurant (fourth concept)
data.location: 1736 Spruce St., Philadelphia, PA 19103 (former Barclay Pharmacy)
data.short_description: Chefs Amanda Shulman and Alex Kemp plan to open a new restaurant in the former Barclay Pharmacy space, per a Pennsylvania Liquor Control Board application. It will be Libbie Loup Hospitality's fourth concept. The group also operates Her Place Supper Club and My Loup.

Evie's by Champagne & Charcuterie, owned by Karen Kirkland, is planning a new Callahan location. The business currently operates at 2380 Sadler Road, Suite 101, in Fernandina Beach. It offers charcuterie boards, grazing tables, catering and workshops.

data.status: proposed; opening date has not yet been set
data.short_description: Garnett Station Partners appears to be pursuing a new Firebirds location at 11506 Regency Village Drive. It would be the chain's second Orlando location. Firebirds currently operates four Florida locations.
Margherita concept Fat Rosie's is pursuing the area off Interstate 4 near the Firebirds site. It is expected to open sometime soon.

data.location: 115 S. Olive St., West Palm Beach (page metadata lists: 115 S Olive Ave., West Palm Beach, FL 33401)
data.status: plans to reopen; moving to 115 S. Olive St.
data.short_description: Hideout Kava & Tea is relocating to 115 S. Olive St., per the Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation. It had temporarily closed for construction in spring 2026. Customers were directed to its other locations during the closure.

data.location: 107 N. Olive St., West Palm Beach
data.short_description: The shop at 107 N. Olive St. announced a temporary closure for construction in spring 2026. The business is relocating to 115 S. Olive St.

data.location: THesis Hotel, Coral Gables (Address not specified)
data.short_description: THesis Hotel will introduce Katsuya, a Japanese restaurant operated by Sam Nazarian of SBE Entertainment Group. The opening is via a partnership with developer Nolan Reynolds International. The restaurant specializes in sushi and robata.

data.store_name: Unnamed Mediterranean concept (led by Fabio Trabocchi)
data.location: THesis Hotel, Coral Gables (Address not specified)
data.short_description: A yet-to-be-named Mediterranean restaurant led by Fabio Trabocchi will open at THesis Hotel. It marks Trabocchi's return to Coral Gables after operating Fiola there from 2018 through 2025. The concept will have a new culinary identity.

data.event_date: Not specified (owner hoping by end of year)
data.status: building their first brick-and-mortar; opening date hasn't yet been announced
data.short_description: Pilsen bagel pop-up Rosca is building its first brick-and-mortar at 1502 W 18th Street. Owner Felix Zepeda hopes to debut it by the end of the year. The menu features Mexican-inspired bagel flavors.

data.location: Route 47 and Cumberland Crossing Blvd, Millville
data.status: plans to open; official opening date has not yet been announced
data.short_description: Wonder food hall plans to open in a new Millville development, per a Paramount Realty site plan. Other proposed tenants include Starbucks, AT&T, Tropical Smoothie Cafe and Aspen Dental. Land clearing has reportedly started.
Chef-owner Christian Hernandez's Barbacana in Downtown Houston has permanently closed after two years. It served its final guests on October 24. The restaurant opened in 2024.

Santa Monica bakery Jyan Isaac Bread will open its second permanent location in Silver Lake on November 2. The space seats 22 indoors plus 12 on the patio. It will offer sourdough, bagels, a cafe menu and alcoholic beverages.

Everson Royce Bar in the Arts District will close permanently on December 20, 2026, after 11 years. Founders Randy Clement and Matt Molina cited the difficulty of doing business in Los Angeles. The bar is known for its patio, cocktails and cheeseburger.
Sibling-owned noodle restaurant Mi La Cay in Little Saigon will close after 34 years. It will serve its last customers on October 29. The restaurant was founded in 1993.

data.location: Inside Hooky at Nashville Yards, 931 Church St, Nashville, TN 37203
data.short_description: Hooky Entertainment Nashville's speakeasy Soundproof will open Oct. 29 inside Hooky at Nashville Yards. It will offer cocktails, light bites and live entertainment. Reservations are available through Resy.

data.location: 3150 East Ray Road, Suite #114, Gilbert, AZ 85296
data.short_description: Mendocino Farms plans to open at Epicenter at Agritopia in Gilbert. The restaurant serves sandwiches and salads. More details will be announced closer to opening.
Pizzeria Mister O1 is opening a new location at The Juniper in Atlanta. The brand also operates in Sandy Springs, Inman Park and Buckhead. It was founded by Renato Viola.

data.location: The Beacon, Grant Park (Address not specified)
data.status: currently under construction; expected to open in February 2027
data.short_description: Brasiliana Pizza is opening a brick-and-mortar restaurant at The Beacon in Grant Park. The concept from Thiago Machado blends Brazilian and Italian influences. The menu will include pizzas, risotto and fresh pasta.

PopUp Bagels has filed plans for a location at 333 E. 17th Street, Suite 21, in Costa Mesa. The plans are pending review and approval, and it could become Orange County's first outpost of the franchise. Franchise group Sweetzer Capital previously signed an agreement to develop 25 locations across SoCal.

data.store_name: Fit 4 You Dance & Gym Wellness Center
data.location: 2100 N Claiborne Ave., New Orleans, LA 70116
data.short_description: Fit 4 You Dance & Gym Wellness Center will combine a dance studio, fitness center, and internet café at 2100 N Claiborne Ave. It is in a former Louisiana Cash Advance location and opens in November. Owner Troy Lovely says it began as a fitness pop-up.

data.location: Henderson Avenue development, near Jenni Kayne, N Henderson Ave, Dallas, TX 75206
data.short_description: MOSCOT is preparing to open its first Dallas store at the Henderson Avenue mixed-use development, occupying approximately 1,000 square feet near Jenni Kayne. The exact storefront address was not disclosed. Most retail tenants at the development are expected to open in March or April 2027.

data.status: An official opening date has not been announced
data.short_description: Beyond Yoga will open its first Dallas store in a new mixed-use development at 1970 N. Henderson Ave. It joins retailers including Frankies Bikinis, Jenni Kayne, Moscot, Vuori, and Lululemon. No official opening date has been announced, though most tenants are expected to open in March or April 2027.

Imago Dei, a faith-centered lifestyle boutique in Downtown Franklin, permanently closed on October 25 after nearly 10 years. It hosted a farewell celebration on October 24 and 25. Owner Sarah Tucker Cash said she closed to focus on her family and the arrival of her second child.

Curl Fitness is preparing to open a gym at Culver Plaza in a former 24 Hour Fitness space. Irvine Company lists it as "coming soon" without a date. The location is already taking reservations online with pre-opening rates.

data.location: 102 6th Ave. North, Suite 7, Jacksonville Beach, Florida 32250
data.short_description: The Tox Technique is preparing to open a body-sculpting and wellness studio at 102 6th Ave. North, Suite 7, this fall. It will be franchisee Stella Ferretti Frutiger's first location. The brand has more than 50 open locations across the US and Canada.

data.status: preparing to bring / building anticipation towards opening
data.short_description: Mystic Mud Kava & Tea Lounge is preparing to open a forest-inspired lounge at 1054 3rd St. N. in the Sea Walk Village commercial area. It will serve kava, kratom teas, herbal teas, and botanical drinks. Its website lists upcoming hours of 10 a.m. to midnight Monday through Wednesday and 10 a.m. to 2 a.m. Thursday through Sunday.

data.status: preparing to reopen / "rounding the corner" and coming back soon
data.short_description: Bootjack, a coffee, bakery, and to-go bites spot, is preparing to reopen at 34 Miller Ave. in Mill Valley. It previously opened in September 2020 at 17 Madrona St. No reopening date or closure reason has been shared.

The Butcher's Daughter will open its first Texas location at 1600 S. Congress Ave. in the former South Congress Café space. It will share the property with Only the Wild Ones and will be the brand's largest location. It will open daily from 8 a.m. to 3 p.m., with dinner service following shortly after.

data.status: will be re-opening / does not yet have an opening date
data.footage_size: 5,020 square feet total across two floors; first floor 3,157 square feet; rooftop deck 1,563 square feet
data.short_description: Palisades Lounge will reopen in its former space at 8211 Georgia Avenue and has submitted a liquor license application. The "Ethio-American food restaurant" will accommodate up to 160 guests. It does not yet have an opening date.
Levain Bakery is preparing to open its first Bay Area location at Santana Row in San Jose. It will take over part of the former Chico's storefront. An opening date has not been announced.

data.location: 18070 San Ramon Valley Blvd., San Ramon, CA 94583
data.event_date: Not specified (Clementine's online ordering system references a reopening date of Nov. 5)
data.short_description: Casa Mia Restaurant is preparing to open in the former Clementine's Restaurant space, its first East Bay location. It will serve Mexican and American food. A debut date has not been announced, though Clementine's online ordering system references a Nov. 5 reopening date.

data.location: 18070 San Ramon Valley Blvd., San Ramon, CA 94583
data.short_description: The owners announced on Instagram that Clementine's had closed. It had operated at the site since 2012, serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner. The space will reopen as Casa Mia.

Chez Mamie, a "European-style play café and wine bar," will open at 4841 Del Ray Avenue in the former Baruch Cafe space. It will feature three skills-based play zones and partner with Lost Sock Roasters, Boulangerie Christophe, Bien Cuit, and BabyCat Brewery. It is set to open in early 2027.

Grocery Outlet is preparing to open a store at 27350 Sun City Blvd. in Menifee. Grocery Outlet Inc. applied for an off-sale beer and wine license at the address. An opening date has not been announced.

A permit application proposes converting an empty commercial space at 2520 S. Colorado Boulevard into Blue Sky Nails & Lash. The project has a construction valuation of $324,000, and its status is "Review in Progress." The previous tenant was an Oakwood Homes sales office.

Preliminary plans propose a Quick Quack Car Wash at 999 S. Colorado Blvd., which currently houses the House of Worship United Pentecostal Church. Plans include an express tunnel car wash, 23 vacuum stations, and 26 parking spaces. The concept plan's status is "Resubmittal Required."

data.status: applied for alcohol licenses / pending as of Oct. 22, 2026
data.short_description: Merchant23 Inc. applied for beer and wine importer, wholesaler, and off-sale licenses at 630 Cordelia Dr. in Santa Rosa. The applications were listed as pending as of Oct. 22, 2026. The licenses would allow the company to import, distribute, and sell beer and wine from the address.

data.location: 3000 E. First Ave., Unit 291, Cherry Creek Shopping Center, Denver, CO 80206
data.short_description: Hollister is planning an interior renovation of its store at Cherry Creek Shopping Center. Building plans were approved on October 22, with a project valuation of $16,180. No construction start or completion date was given.

data.location: 576 Center St., Rheem Valley Shopping Center, Moraga, CA 94556
data.status: construction is underway; opening delayed until early next year
data.short_description: Grocery Outlet is preparing to open a store at 576 Center St. in Moraga's Rheem Valley Shopping Center. Construction is underway, and the opening has reportedly been delayed until early next year. A groundbreaking ceremony was held in December 2025.
